title: Docs: document closedStates in the data-modelling guide with every authoring note, and point the approvals guide at it (ADR-0162 item 5)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: ADR-0162 Execution item 5 (accepted by merge 972114df)

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：在建模文档里讲清楚「已关闭状态」怎么声明、声明后会发生什么，并在审批文档里「审批结束后记录解锁」的地方加上指引。
- 用户会看到什么：应用作者能在文档里查到声明一发布旧单据立刻关闭、动作按钮仍然能改已关闭单据、怎么给用户留一条「重新打开」的路。
- 不做会怎样：作者只能从报错里摸索规则，最容易踩的几处（声明立即生效、审批后的自动化被拒）没有任何预警。
- 顺序：排在声明和执行那张卡之后，文档只写已经上线的行为。

## What happens

`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` says a record unlocks when its approval is decided (two passages, `git grep -n "the record unlocks" origin/main -- content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`). Nothing in `content/docs/data-modeling/` tells an author how to keep a decided document closed, because the platform could not do it.

The recommendations the maintainer adopted on 2026-11-26, 「全部按推荐」 (ruling record 7200732942 on #36253, text on record 7202242844), ask for three authoring notes by name. ADR-0162 "Consequences" lists the rest.

## Expected

- **The data-modelling guide documents the key**: its shape, what a field must be, the unit (the record and its direct `master_detail` lines), what is refused and for whom, the refusal's code, and the way out.
- **Every authoring note of ADR-0162 "What an author has to know"**, none left out:
  - publishing a declaration closes existing records at once;
  - automation that acts as the caller is refused on a closed record, the steps after an approval decision included;
  - code that calls the engine with no context is bound like a caller;
  - an action button still works on a closed document, and an action that must not run on one checks the state in its body;
  - the way out is an action with a script body, or a flow that runs as system;
  - a closed document keeps its owner;
  - line edits go before the closing write, and a finished document is not created together with its lines by a caller;
  - the lock read tells every reader of a document that it is closed, so a field whose state is confidential to some readers is not declared;
  - a parent is not deleted while a closed document hangs below it.
- **The three notes the ruling asks for by name**: what an action button does on a closed document, what the lock read tells a reader who may not see the state field, and a new approval of a closed document, with what an abandoned approval leaves behind.
- **The approvals guide's "the record unlocks" passages gain a pointer** to closed states. What a field and a flow owe an approval on an object that closes on its outcome is written by the approvals card (item 7), which owns that part of the guide; this card links to it and does not restate it.
- **An action's registered handler is named beside the script body** wherever the docs say what runs elevated: a handler registered for a script action runs through the same context as the body (review note N15).

## Done when

- [ ] The data-modelling page exists, is linked from the section's navigation, and carries each note above.
- [ ] Each of the three notes the ruling names can be found by its own heading.
- [ ] Both "the record unlocks" passages point at closed states.
- [ ] Every example in the page is a declaration the shipped schema accepts (the doc-authoring gates pass).
- [ ] The showcase's declaration (item 3) is the worked example, or the page says why it is not.
- [ ] The key's own PR names this card on its `Skills-docs:` line, and the `skills/**` follow-up card is filed apart.

Category ③: maintainer-directed. A build card of ADR-0162, child of #36253.
Grade: area:data · Feature · n/a (not a defect) · reach: every author who declares the key · evidence: read (the approvals guide on `main` at `972114df`, ADR-0162 "Consequences")
Suggested-grade: p2 · part of the feature #36253; the ruling asks for three of the notes by name
Size: M (one new page, edits to the approvals guide, navigation, examples that the doc gates check).
Business reason: carried from #36253. An author who declares the key changes what every user of the document can do, at once and with no grace period.
Reader: seat 2 (repo:objectstack#2), a card thread, effort medium to high.
Blocked-by: #37768 (item 1) (the docs describe shipped behaviour). The lock-read note also waits for item 2.
Clause-②: no. Prose under `content/docs/**`.
